<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, indicating a molecular weight near 193 Da. A common aromatic compound with this mass is para‑hydroxyacetophenone (4‑hydroxyacetophenone), whose molecular formula C₁₁H₁₂O₃ gives an [M+H]⁺ exact mass of 193.086 Da, matching the observed ion within typical instrument tolerance. The SMILES representation for this structure is “CC(=O)c1ccc(O)cc1”.</thought>
